## Blockers and approvals

- Blockers, next action and owner (or none):
- Approvals needed: exact action + target. "fix"/"implement" = local only; "publish" = commits +

  git commands, deployments and every live Supabase change each need separate explicit approval.

Completed assignment does not mean merged, deployed or production-verified; record each separately.
